_about: THE DOCUMENT GROUPS (order 14, planner 26 Nov 2026 14:45, lane L3; builder H). DATA, not code: `app/document_groups.py` reads it, no model. Each group is one kind of document a contractor sends, in ONE of the six review families of the one kind list (`kind_list.json`, builder G). `kind`: the kind on that list the group is (null when the list has no kind for it). `words`: the names code matches, as whole words, against what the review already holds (the AI's subject of the paper and the paper's file name); a name is lower case, plain words, and never a client's word. A paper whose kind is on the kind list keeps that kind and its family. A paper of no listed kind is placed by its group's words; with no group either it goes to the NEAREST family by shared words (or `default_family`), is logged 'new kind seen' and is labelled 'not yet scored for this kind' on its comment sheet: it is never refused. `families.<id>.route_kind`: the method kind whose rules and method books a paper of that family is reviewed with when its own kind is not one the method knows (an unscored kind stays unscored: no switch opens Automatic for it). Filling in the client's document list (93 groups) adds rows under `groups` and changes nothing else.
